question: Which of the following name was used for the Indian subcontinent by ancient travellers like Megasthenes, FaHien, Huen Tsang, Al Beruni, Ibn Batuta etc. for the active contribution of Indian traders?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Bhoomi.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swaran Bhoomi**

 
 
• **'Swaran Bhoomi'** was used for the Indian subcontinent by ancient travellers like** Megasthenes, FaHien, Huen Tsang, Al Beruni, Ibn Batuta etc.**
 
• Between the first to seventh centuries, India was the largest economy of the ancient and Medieval World.
 
• Approximately** one-third to one-fourth** **of the world's wealth** is under their control.
 
• In the writings of several travelers, the country was referred to as** Swaranbhumi and Swaran deep.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suvarnabhumi **appears in many ancient Indian literary sources and Buddhist texts.
 
• Suvarnabhumi means **"Golden Land".**
 
• Ancient sources have associated it with one of a variety of places throughout the Southeast Asia region.
 
• There were texts mentioning Suvarnabhumi as a land of fortune where an Ancient Prince's ship was boarded for trade.
 
• Suvarnabhumi is known to be a land of richness and abundance.
